acceptanceCriteria: A test or measurement proves the two lexers' tokens equal on the repository, or names each of the four differences and its selection impact.
If equal, one lexer serves both scans, selection output is byte-identical, and the dry-run median is re-measured and reported against 3.90 s.
body: After V1-2169 the measured median of  is 3.90 s. The affected-graph scan and gateselect.indexRepository each lex every Go source with separate lexers that differ in four ways. Expected: one shared lexer/token stream per invocation. Actual: two lexers. Step 1 must prove token equality (or document the four differences and their effect on selection) before sharing. Related: V1-1880, V1-2169. Versions: Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 (build 698); corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.698. Source: lane speed-1021, PR beamfall/corvint#1416, 2026-10-21.
title: corvint test --dry-run runs two lexers over the same sources; share one after proving token equality (follow-up to V1-1880)
